decision: 仅放行幽灯茶壶 T01、鬼火珠碗 P01 与对应两处空柜清底的代表样片。Art 与 Tech 同批预签实存且批准记录成立后才产首张 PNG／PSD；代表实图与 alpha 核通过后另签全批，未签不得扩批。

representative_objects.name: 幽灯茶
representative_objects.object: 透明茶壶本体（含壶内可见幻想茶液），不含木格、常亮框、文字和相邻像素

representative_objects.name: 鬼火珠
representative_objects.object: 鬼火珠与承装碗本体，碗和食材可另设子层；不含木格、常亮框、文字和相邻像素

tooling.method: 冻结 RGB 源图的确定性语义遮罩与局部缺失信息修复；image2psd 仅用于经过核验的全画布透明语义层组装，不能以 split-colors 或整图盖顶冒充分层

pixel_contract.source: RGB8, unprofiled; interpret as sRGB without altering source pixels
pixel_contract.export: PNG RGBA8, straight alpha, transparent outside actual semantic silhouette; SrcOver in sRGB working space; no premultiplied export
pixel_contract.roi_rule: ROI is a loose safety window, not a rectangular cutout; final nonzero-alpha bounds and pivot measured from real mask and recorded in CUT_MANIFEST.json
pixel_contract.alpha_checks: background corners A=0; object interior A>0; soft edges retained; no shelf/frame/text/neighbor contamination; alpha and RGB must reconstruct at the source coordinates
pixel_contract.shelf_rule: Only T01/P01 vacated slots may be locally cleaned in representative stage; record change mask, preserve every pixel outside it

limits: 本签不是具体资源用户 Gate2 批准；暂不放行其他 10 种、杯内内容、顾客或整屏母版。
